meta.title: Olives Boutique Resort Digital Marketing — Case Study | Teknoppy
meta.description: How Teknoppy runs social media campaigns and community handling for Olives Boutique Resort, a Wayanad eco-resort, across Instagram and Facebook.

meta.label: Key Services
meta.value: Digital Marketing, Social Media Campaign Management, Social Media Handling

paragraphs.text: Olives Boutique Resort is a Kalpetta, Wayanad eco-friendly resort run by owners Biju and Raji, known for home-cooked meals, mountain views, and personal hospitality across its honeymoon, family, and budget stay packages.

paragraphs.html: Note: this case study is scoped to social media campaign running and handling — see the separate SEO/site restructure case study for this client for the website work.

items.title: Inconsistent posting and engagement
items.text: Without a structured content and campaign plan, activity on Instagram and Facebook was likely irregular, making it harder to build a consistent following.

items.title: No campaign link to existing packages
items.text: Honeymoon, family, and budget stay packages already offered on the website weren't necessarily reflected in social content, missing a direct path from social engagement to booking.

items.title: No structured visual storytelling
items.text: A boutique eco-resort with strong review themes (home-cooked meals, mountain views, host hospitality) needs a deliberate content strategy to turn those strengths into recurring social content, which wasn't yet in place.

paragraphs.text: Teknoppy's goal was to run social media campaigns and community handling across Instagram and Facebook that could turn the resort's real strengths — reviews consistently praising its food, views, and host warmth — into consistent, booking-driven content.

sections.h2: A comprehensive range of services offered by Teknoppy and their outcomes

items.title: A structured content and posting calendar
items.text: Regular content across Instagram and Facebook keeps the resort's presence active and consistent rather than sporadic.

items.title: Campaigns aligned to existing packages
items.text: Honeymoon, family, and budget package messaging is carried into social campaigns, connecting content directly to what visitors can book.

items.title: Visual storytelling built around the resort's real strengths
items.text: The pool, mountain views, home-cooked meals, and the hosts' hospitality — recurring themes across guest reviews — are used as ongoing content pillars.

items.title: Community handling and review amplification
items.text: Guest comments and engagement are actively managed, and positive review themes are reflected back into social content, reinforcing the trust already built on platforms like Google and TripAdvisor.

paragraphs.text: Discovery, content planning, and campaign specifics for this engagement — timeline and key decisions — should be pulled from the project intake and added here once confirmed.
